description: This file defines the class FirstMoment in the org.apache.commons.math3.stat.descriptive.moment package. It computes the first statistical moment (mean) using a recursive algorithm, as part of the Apache Commons Math library. The class maintains the count of values and the current mean, providing methods to increment, clear, copy, and retrieve the current mean value.

classes.name: FirstMoment
classes.description: Class to compute the first moment (mean) of a data set using an efficient recursive algorithm.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Updates the internal mean value with a new data point using recursive formula.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state, clearing all accumulated data.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the number of values added so far.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of the current FirstMoment instance.
